title: [Bug] <In the "Important Links" section, the link gets copied twice when opened.>
body: **Describe the bug**
When clicking on a link in the "Important Links" section, the link opens but is copied twice.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Open the app and go to the "Important Links" section.
2. Click on any link.
3. The link opens, but it is copied twice.

**Expected behavior**
Clicking on the link should only open the link in a browser or another relevant app without copying it.

**Screenshots**
![bug](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f093309d-1093-4ed1-a285-6d1ee3b3eb69)

**Smartphone (please complete the following information):**
 - Device: [Vivo z5x]
 - OS: [OriginOS1.0]

**Additional context**
It seems that the link is being copied twice after it is opened. The issue could be related to the app's link handling mechanism, which needs adjustment to prevent duplication.

title: [bug] multiple tag deletion doesn't work
body: Steps to recreate:
1. Go to tags section in the side menu
2. Add at least 2 tags
3. Hold one of them
4. Tap on "select more"
5. Select at least 2 tags
6. Tap the 3 dots above
7. Tap the "delete"
8. Observe menu closing and deletion not happening.

Quillpad installed from F-Droid.

Also gonna take this occasion to notify that I added Quillpad to my TagsResearch collection and ask a question.

Were the tags your own feature as a fork of Quillnote?

I was using Quillnote for few years and never noticed that option then. But I also only used it for strictly pure text notes so I didn't use a lot of the options there - just a Google Keep alternative for notes.

Here's Quillpad entry in TagsResearch if anybody's interested:
https://github.com/Qronikarz/TagsResearch/blob/main/components/quillpad.md

html_url: https://github.com/quillpad/quillpad/issues/374
